messages:
Elena: Quick ask — 3/26 backend panel (9:30am PT) candidate A needs coverage. I just had a conflict, can't make the panel. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/meet/abc123. Debrief doc: https://docs.redwood.com/sheets/debrief-candidateA. Can someone pick up the 9:30 slot? Ideally someone who can ask infra + systems Qs.
Jordan: I can take it if Samir can't. Free 9:30-10:30.
Priya: I can swap my 11am slot for 9:30 if Jordan wants 11. @Jordan?
Samir: I can cover infra Qs but need to leave by 10:00 — is the panel likely to run past 9:50?
Elena: Thanks. Panel usually ~40 mins. If you need to cut, start with infra then hand to systems.
Maya K: Also FYI — please add candidate's timezone to the sheet, it's CET.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: please complete the debrief within 24h after panel. :bell:
Jordan: @Priya okay to swap? I can do 11.
Priya: yep will move calendar and update sheet. :+1: 
Samir: One rubric question — do we use 1-5 scale for 'system design depth' or 'pass/needs-work'? Sometimes I mix them.
Elena: Use 1-5 for all subcriteria. Pass threshold: average >=3.5 and no 1s. Add comment if any 2s.
Elena: "Scoring: 1=poor, 2=below expectations, 3=meets, 4=above, 5=exceptional. If any 1 -> flag for concrete concerns."
Priya: Got it. For question order, infra first (Samir), then systems (me), then product fit (Jordan)?
Samir: Sounds good. Also can someone start recording? I won't be able to take full notes.
Jordan: I'll start recording and take notes for infra handoff. Will annotate timestamps in the debrief doc.
Elena: Thanks. Also accommodation: candidate asked for 15m extra at start for processing time. Should we allow? @People Ops
People Ops Bot: Accommodation note logged. Please confirm in calendar invite.
Maya K: Confirmed — added 15m buffer and updated calendar invites. Also set "No code editor during live coding" per candidate preference — use whiteboard instead.
Priya: Quick procedural — use this snippet in debrief for rubric anchor: `example: For system design, ask about tradeoffs in scaling from 1k to 1M rps, expect discussion of caching, sharding, backpressure.`
Samir: Thanks — will prep follow-ups.
Jordan: All set from my side. :thumbsup:
Elena: You're all heroes. I'll update the candidate tracker and send final calendar. Please mark "will cover" in the sheet if you're taking the slot.
